Scrambled egg whites, about 150 g at roughly 52 kcal/100 g, give around 80 kcal. Roasted potato cubes, about 90 g with oil, add roughly 140 kcal. Salsa verde or green sauce, about 60 g, adds around 25 kcal, or more if it contains oil. That makes a total of about 300 g and roughly 250 kcal.
